records.name: pdp.response.wizard.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form string="Send Response Message">
                <sheet>
                    <group>
                        <field name="available_statuses" invisible="1"/>  
                        <field name="status" required="True" widget="dynamic_selection" options="{'available_field': 'available_statuses'}"/>
                        <field name="reason_code" invisible="not show_reason_code"/>
                        <field name="currency_id" invisible="1"/>  
                        <field name="fully_paid" invisible="move_count != 1 or status != 'PD'"/>
                        <field name="paid_amount" invisible="fully_paid or move_count != 1 or status != 'PD'"/>
                        <field name="note" nolabel="1" placeholder="Enter an optional note here..."/>
                    </group>
                </sheet>

                <footer>
                    <button name="button_send" string="Send" type="object" class="btn-primary" data-hotkey="q"/>
                    <button string="Discard" class="btn-secondary" special="cancel" data-hotkey="x"/>
                </footer>
            </form>
        </field>
